note: Expectations written by hand for frames with no keys (docs/import-intent/PHASE-1.md, Step 6). `members` lists the layers a member should fill in, by Figma node id. Every other text or image the import lands is expected to stay fixed. Run eval.mjs --list to see a frame's layers.

frames.why: The headline, the photo, the subheading and the subcopy change with every post. The web address is the same on all of them, and the logo is artwork.
The prompt typed into the composer is the one line a post would change. The platform, the variations label and its count are the product's own interface.
